All plans have a very fast cap and they get throttled to 10Mbps down 1 up. And if you have a fixed IP it gets even worse mostly i love what ethereum stands for and i don't know i would really apprciate some guidance The threat just got real from ASICs. https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-1057-break-glass-moment-is-here/5255/12?u=cryptoblockchaintech what's the threat? they are trying to sell their pre-used asics would have been a threat if they kept it in silence ;P Question: Why has development of an EIP (969/3369/3372) to remove asics from the network been left to the community instead of ether devs working on this issue, when the ether white paper clearly states that the network should not allow asic mining?
